After the missile strike on the Naager fortress from space ended in complete failure, a heavy silence hung over the TDF Far East Base…
A Dimensional Distortion Field? Is that what they called it?

Yes, sir…

The Amigo… I mean, UCMA's [HERO2] and the others heard it from Atefarina.

Yes, sir…

The Amigo… I mean, UCMA's [HERO2] and the others heard it from Atefarina.
What exactly is a Dimensional Distortion Field?

Well, to put it simply…

think of matter sucked into a black hole passing through a wormhole and being spat out of a white hole.

It's a kind of door that lets you travel freely between all dimensions.
Is something like that possible?
In theory, it is.
If that door were opened here on Earth…
If we assume it would be used for evil… the damage would be limitless.
Good grief! Then the Earth is as good as in their hands!
The Dimensional Distortion Field… a door connecting one space to another, so to speak.
Opening this field on Earth, which would let anyone arrive on Earth instantly even from a planet tens of thousands of light-years away, was Zephas's aim!
Invaders could reach the Earth without meeting any resistance. In other words, opening it meant rendering Earth's defenses powerless…

But… Steel Emperor Zephas is an Earthling just like us. And the former head of SIDO, no less!

Why would he do this…?
My predecessor was Director Sawa, if I remember right?
Yes, sir… He is the father of Captain Sawa, who now leads the special forces unit.
Captain Sawa, huh…
Director! The Space Fortress Naager has begun to move!
What's its course?
